learning.title: Style Learning
learning.subtitle: Let AI read chapters you've polished to build a personal style profile. When enabled, future chapter generation will mirror your voice.
learning.emptyCorpus: No learnable chapters yet. Write a few chapters and set their status to "Revised / Polished / Final" (these are the ones you shaped by hand and best represent your style), or save a revision pair first.
learning.learnHint: Reads up to {{maxChapters}} chapters at a time, {{maxChars}} characters each; revision pairs inject at most 3 short excerpts instead of full chapters.
learning.errorMaxChapters: To keep input costs in check, select at most {{max}} chapters at a time. Deselect one before adding more.
learning.errorEmptyResponse: AI returned no content. Please try again.
learning.profileStats: Profile learned from {{chapters}} chapters (~{{words}} words). Edit below; changes auto-save on blur.
learning.revisionPairsSectionHint: {{count}} / 8 pairs saved; samples with author notes take priority during learning.

calibration.title: Interactive Calibration
calibration.subtitle: Test the current profile with a short passage. AI rewrites only this text; confirm and edit before saving so unconfirmed output never contaminates your style samples.
calibration.sourcePlaceholder: Paste a short passage to calibrate (up to {{max}} characters)
calibration.feedbackPlaceholder: Optional: what felt right / what still misses
calibration.errorEmptyResult: AI returned no calibration draft. Please try again.
calibration.toastPairSaved: Before/after pair saved; it will be prioritized next time you re-learn the profile

revisionPairs.empty: No revision pairs yet. Use "Compare & Polish" in the chapter editor and save, or run an interactive calibration below to start collecting samples.
revisionPairs.notePlaceholder: Explain why you rewrote it this way (auto-saves on blur; noted samples are prioritized during learning)
